rules.name: Mechanised Doctrine
rules.description:
While a friendly **^^Astra Militarum Infantry^^** unit is embarked within a friendly **^^Astra Militarum Transport^^**, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of that **^^Transport^^**.

Each time a friendly **^^Astra Militarum Infantry^^** unit disembarks from a **^^Transport^^** in your turn, until the end of that turn, attacks made with **[HEAVY]** weapons equipped by models in that unit can benefit from the **[HEAVY]** ability even though that unit was set up on the battlefield this turn, provided no model in that unit has moved more than 3" since it disembarked.

rules.name: Stratagem: Mechanised Spearhead (1CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Start of the first battle round, before the first turn begins. Use once per battle. **Target:** One friendly **^^Astra Militarum Transport^^** unit and any unit embarked within it. **Effect:** Remove that **^^Transport^^** from the battlefield and set it up again anywhere on the battlefield that is wholly within 18" of any battlefield edge and more than 9" horizontally from all enemy units.

rules.name: Stratagem: Open Hatches! (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Your Shooting phase, when a friendly **^^Astra Militarum Transport^^** with one or more units embarked within it is selected to shoot. **Target:** That **^^Transport^^**. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, add 2 to that **^^Transport^^**'s Firing Deck value, and each time a model makes an attack with a weapon selected via Firing Deck, you can re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

rules.name: Stratagem: Treads Forward! (1CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your Movement phase, just before a friendly **^^Astra Militarum Transport^^** is selected to move. **Target:** That **^^Transport^^**. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, add 3" to the Move characteristic of that **^^Transport^^**. In addition, if it Advances this phase, units embarked within it can still disembark this turn.

rules.name: Stratagem: Disembark and Fire! (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Your Shooting phase, when a friendly **^^Astra Militarum Infantry^^** unit that disembarked from a **^^Transport^^** this turn is selected to shoot. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, **[HEAVY]** weapons equipped by models in that unit have the **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** ability.

rules.name: Stratagem: Hull-down Defense (1CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after a friendly **^^Astra Militarum Transport^^** is selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks. **Target:** That **^^Transport^^**. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets that **^^Transport^^**, subtract 1 from the Wound roll, and that **^^Transport^^** has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

rules.name: Stratagem: Smokescreen Surge (1CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** End of your Movement phase. **Target:** Every friendly **^^Astra Militarum Transport^^** on the battlefield that did not Advance this turn. **Effect:** Until the start of your next turn, those **^^Transports^^** have the Stealth ability.
